title: S&P 500 Price, Real-time Quote & News - Google Finance

knownGaps.why: Genuine limitation. An index page quotes a $37.56 figure beside a $61.1 trillion total — twelve orders of magnitude. The median grid gives two decimals, which the significant-figure cap then strips entirely from the trillions.

OPEN PRODUCT QUESTION, not a parse error: $61.1 trillion converts correctly to 78,333,333,333 ZEC. It is also 3,700 times the entire 21 million ZEC supply, rendered as eleven digits. This is the clearest case in the corpus that a correct conversion can still be a useless one: nothing above 21,000,000 ZEC can be held, quoted or compared, so rendering it as a ZEC quantity states something that cannot be true of any holder. Whether these should convert at all, render coarsely, or stay in fiat is undecided; recorded, not fixed.
